analysis.title: SOX's Gain = AAPL's Pain
key_insights: Semis are poised for a counter-trend rally over the next 5-10 days. Following the 2000 analog, the SOX could rally 15-18% from Friday's lows, almost back to the early October highs, before rolling over again.
AAPL has a negative 90% correlation with the SOX on a 10-day basis. SOX just fell 16%, the tech sector 9% and Mag7 5%, while AAPL is just off all-time highs.
BTIG expects AAPL to pull back toward its 50 DMA (327) at a minimum as SOX bounces.
At a minimum SOX should rally back toward its 20 DMA. After the rally BTIG would look to reduce semis exposure again.
SMH vs. MAGS has pulled back to its 200 DMA for the first time in over a year. BTIG expects a near-term rebound in SMH relative to MAGS, and says an AAPL pullback should also be a headwind for Mag7.

market_movers.rationale: BTIG says it is time to fade AAPL. It expects a pullback toward the 50 DMA (327) as semis bounce, given the negative 90% 10-day correlation with SOX.

sector_views.rationale: Tactical counter-trend rally expected over 5-10 days after a 16% SOX pullback, with a view to reduce exposure again after the bounce.
